_comment: BAS1 (Issue 3) Task 4 -- E1 baseline run registry. Per the issue's literal text this is SEVEN named items: four centralized (non-FL) baselines + three FL runs. This file is a documentation/launch registry, not something main.py loads directly -- config_loader.py only loads experiments/configs/hyperparams.json (DAT1 Task 2). Each entry below states exactly how to launch it. Runs marked "launcher": "main.py" are executed via the commands in "launch_command"; the centralized runs use a separate (non-FL) training script that is NOT part of this handoff's files -- see the 'centralized_runs_note' field on each of those four entries.

runs.note: Architecture-only ablation: GroupNorm+DPLSTM (dp_safe=True) with NO DP-SGD noise (use_dp=False), isolating the architecture swap's effect from the DP mechanism's effect. THIS IS THE ROW THE DRAFT CONFIG WAS MISSING (handoff correction #3) -- main.py's DP_SAFE was previously derived automatically as `DP_SAFE = USE_DP`, which could not express dp_safe=True with use_dp=False simultaneously. Real code change made this session: a new --force-dp-safe-arch CLI flag was added and DP_SAFE is now `USE_DP or _args.force_dp_safe_arch`. This is real code work, not just a config entry -- see main.py diff.
runs.status: CODE CHANGE MADE AND STATICALLY VERIFIED (py_compile passes; argparse namespace confirmed to set force_dp_safe_arch=True and thread through to DP_SAFE derivation).
